title: Every k-th Leaves the Circle
statement:
`n` people stand in a circle in the given order; person `i` carries the number `a_i`. Counting starts at the first person and goes around the circle: the first person says `1`, the next says `2`, and so on. The person who says `k` leaves the circle, and counting restarts from the next person with `1`. This repeats until one person is left.

Print the number carried by the last person.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `k`. The second line contains `a_1 ... a_n`.

## Output
Print the number carried by the survivor.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 16000`
- `1 <= k <= 10^9`
- `1 <= a_i <= 10^9`
